verdict.rationale: Edge0 is a local LLM inference engine. Its documented chat features (one-shot chat, an OpenAI-compatible /v1/chat/completions server) let users talk to a hosted model, not operate Edge0 itself. Fetching models, serving, toggling adapters and benchmarking are all driven by explicit CLI flags and Python APIs. A runtime could plausibly ship natural-language control of its own operations, so the axis applies, but there is no evidence of it.
